title: #3 Keeping Fit
prompt: A healthy diet is more important for keeping fit than exercise. To what extent do you agree with this statement? Give an example or personal experiences.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main point is that good food provides the necessary energy and nutrients for the body to function well.
